eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Mesa; Garfield; Eagle; Summit; Clear Creek; Jefferson; Denver; Broomfield; Adams; Arapahoe; Douglas; Boulder; Gilpin, CO; at 12:01 PM on SEP 22, 2026 Effective until 3:01 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Colorado Bureau of Investigation with and AMBER Child Abduction Alert. We have received this important announcement regarding an abducted Child in Arvada. The (Arvada Police Department is searching for 8 year old, Zayden Castillo last seen in the vicinity of the 9080 block of Oberon Road in Arvada at about 9:30 this morning. Zayden is described as a white, male, four feet five inches tall, fifty pounds, black hair and brown eyes. Zayden was last seen wearing a red Van's t-shirt, khaki shorts, black Jordans shoes, and a black backpack. Investigators believe Zayden may have been taken by his grandfather, Doyle Stewart, 57 years old, bald with blue eyes, six feet tall and one hundred and sixty pounds who was last seen wearing a beige baseball cap, grey t-shirt, shorts, and black glasses. They may be traveling in a 2011 black Ford F250 bearing Colorado license plate E   T   Z   Y  4  1 that was last seen near 52nd and Yarrow Street in Arvada at 10:16AM. The vehicle has a toolbox or work equipment in the bed as well as a blue script sticker on the left rear windshield. They may be traveling to the Grand Junction area. If you have any information regarding this abduction, immediately call 9 1  1.
